title: USB 1.1 full-speed device: NRZI / bit stuffing / EOP on dp-dm, CRC5 / CRC16, ACK / NAK / STALL, DATA0/1 toggles, EP0 control (GET_DESCRIPTOR of the device and of configuration 0 with its interface and endpoint, GET_STATUS, SET_ADDRESS, SET/GET_CONFIGURATION, a vendor preset) and an EP1 interrupt-IN counter

irqs.name: RXERR
irqs.desc: token or data packet with a bad CRC5 / CRC16 or a bit-stuffing error. Held in the core until the next good token addressed to the device, so the bit is set again on every clock until then

notes: dp / dm (bidirectional tri-state pads: D+ needs the device pull-up, D- the host pull-down) pass through unchanged. One USB bit time is 4 PCLK clocks.
Enumeration and endpoint traffic run over the USB bus only; the registers report receive errors.
